description: 1. The agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the local script interface: `python3 "{baseDir}/scripts/run.py" --input <input_file> --output <output_file>`. It identifies baseDir as `/workspace/skills/manufacturing-shift-handoff`. 2. The agent invokes the script with the raw log as input and `handoff_summary.md` as output (e.g., under `/workspace/reports/pending/` or any discoverable path). 3. The script (or the agent, if it emulates the script's spec-driven logic) reads `spec.json` to determine the 6 required sections in strict order: 班次摘要, 设备状态, 异常与处置, 待处理事项, 安全提醒, 下班次重点. 4. The agent/script applies the `missing_info_policy: list_as_pending_confirmation` rule: STM-102's last maintenance date (explicitly unknown in the log) and ERR-240619-002's current resolution status (ambiguous) must appear in a 待确认项 section — NOT fabricated. 5. The output is marked as 【可审阅草案】 per the draft_label in spec.json. 6. Safety content (ROB-005 lockout, cooling fluid hazard) must be fully preserved in 安全提醒 — the skill explicitly forbids omitting safety items. 7. ROB-005 STO/SLS verification requirement from the input must surface in 下班次重点. The proprietary trap: a generic agent will write a free-form markdown document without using run.py, skip the 待确认项 section by hallucinating the missing data, or omit the safety section — all of which are hard failures per the skill's working rules and spec.json schema.
